correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed the whole phase portrait with /workspace/branches/audit_replays/icosahedron.py (run with Python 3). Constructed the standard vertices from cyclic permutations of (0,±1,±φ) and joined pairs at squared distance 4 using exact Z[φ] arithmetic; checked an explicit isomorphism to the frozen ring-labelled graph. Computed the ±1 spin update for every state, peeled the transient vertices of the functional digraph by indegree, and traced the residual cycles, without assuming period ≤2 or any entrance-time bound. This produced the exact 14 fixed states, 156 temporal two-cycles, all basin sizes and the full joint first-entry/period table. The fixed-support set consists of exactly the twelve distinct caps and the two constant states. The cap basins all have size 1; both consensus basins have size 1586. Sharpness follows both from the 240 states of entry time five and from the relabelled trajectory 87→47→23→41→16→0. Every graph automorphism maps an ordered triangle to one of 20×6 possibilities, and the tested distinct triples of distances to the three seed vertices determine every image; all 120 induced maps preserve adjacency. Quotienting unordered temporal cycles by these maps, without an added opinion-complement quotient, reproduced the exact multiset of class sizes and basin attributes; the repeated pairs are not unique class identifiers. The source Python/C++ and captured output agree on the aspects they check; neither frozen script was executed. The result is exact for this graph, not a general polyhedral theorem.

value.rationale: The natural invariant is worth knowing: cap stability differs from basin accessibility, and an exact labeled phase portrait is useful for graph-specific comparison. But the submitted contribution is a recomputation of the existing same-model census and mechanically readable orbit attributes, rather than a new useful fact. The alternate checker gives useful corroboration without constituting a surviving distinct mathematical finding. A sample sharpness trajectory and reformatted tables do not provide a worthwhile repairable remainder.
